published_training_result.final_model_training: full data, including former validation identities; DO NOT evaluate this model on that holdout

official_identity_search.method: All Saner molecule and all fold0 structure rows scanned; heavy composition recomputed/cached from actual SMILES, then all composition-compatible rows canonicalized with official stereo-before-tautomer identity. No full-formula gate.
official_identity_search.scope: Only audited targets; declared intersection count alone is not equivalence-audited.

limitations: Published producer declarations and checkpoint metadata support training scope, but do not reconstruct historical minibatches.
Saner best checkpoint was selected using up to the first 1000 validation identities: training-unseen does not mean untouched model-selection holdout.
Published prepare.py lacks normalized_smiles alias despite data_audit naming that input; exact producer revision/provenance remains unresolved.
An eligible pair of neural components does not certify FPNet/ICE/GL/GBDT/whole Flex stack as unseen.
Full candidate set and split must be frozen before component scoring. Current pilot and previous public panels are diagnostic development evidence, not pristine final holdout.

nonrepresentative_fold0_variants.scope: All original raw-key/SMILES pairs outside train_structs representatives, with fold assignments resolved by raw key/sid.

checkpoint_selection_candidates.scope: All evaluated candidate identities including decoys, rather than query identities alone.
